sentences.en: I'm David Marchese.

sentences.en: As a former rock journalist myself,
sentences.zh: 作为一名曾经的摇滚记者，

sentences.en: Cameron Crowe's career always seemed impossibly cool and impossible to replicate.
sentences.zh: 卡梅伦·克罗的职业生涯总是显得酷到不可思议，而且无法复制。

sentences.en: He got his start as a teenager in the 70s, going on the road and hanging out with the likes of Led Zeppelin,
sentences.zh: 他70年代十几岁时出道，为《滚石》杂志奔赴巡演途中，与齐柏林飞艇等大牌厮混，

sentences.en: The Eagles, and David Bowie for Rolling Stone magazine.
sentences.zh: 还有老鹰乐队和大卫·鲍伊。

sentences.en: Trust me, that does not happen anymore.
sentences.zh: 相信我，这种事现在绝不会发生了。

sentences.en: He would eventually turn those experiences and his mother's completely understandable worries about them into his classic film Almost Famous from 2000,
sentences.zh: 他后来把那些经历，以及他母亲对此完全可以理解的担忧，化作了他2000年的经典电影《成名在望》，

sentences.en: which he directed and which won him the Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay.
sentences.zh: 该片由他执导，并为他赢得了奥斯卡最佳原创剧本奖。

sentences.en: Those experiences are also the backbone of his new memoir, The Uncool.
sentences.zh: 这些经历也是他新回忆录《不酷》的骨干。

sentences.en: But the book's tight focus on those early days means there's kind of a lot left untapped.
sentences.zh: 但这本书对早期岁月的紧密聚焦，意味着有很多东西没有被挖掘出来。

sentences.en: That includes Crowe's transition to writer-director of beloved films like Say Anything, Singles, and Jerry Maguire, as well as some thornier subjects,
sentences.zh: 这包括克罗转型为编剧兼导演，创作了《情到深处》、《单身一族》和《甜心先生》等备受喜爱的电影，以及一些更棘手的主题，

sentences.en: like the end of his marriage to musician Nancy Wilson, and what some people, myself included, see as a real change in the quality of his more recent work.
sentences.zh: 比如他与音乐人南希·威尔逊婚姻的结束，以及某些人（包括我自己）所认为的他近期作品质量的真正下滑。

sentences.en: So what happened?
sentences.zh: 所以发生了什么？

sentences.en: And has any of that tougher stuff chipped away at the idealism at the center of his earlier successes?
sentences.zh: 那些更艰难的事情，有没有磨灭他早期成功核心处的理想主义？

sentences.en: There's a lot to talk about.
sentences.zh: 有很多可以聊的。

sentences.en: Here's my conversation with Cameron Crowe.
sentences.zh: 以下是我与卡梅伦·克罗的对话。

sentences.en: Cameron, thank you for taking the time to talk with me today.
sentences.zh: 卡梅伦，谢谢你今天抽出时间跟我聊聊。

sentences.en: So great to be doing this, and thanks for you taking the time.
sentences.zh: 能做这个访谈太棒了，也谢谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: You know, so the memoir overlaps with the Almost Famous story in a way.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，所以这本回忆录在某种程度上与《成名在望》的故事有重叠。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, both in terms of the beginning of your career and some of the family dynamics that you were living through at the time, particularly with your mom.
sentences.zh: 你知道，无论是在你职业生涯的开端，还是你在当时经历的一些家庭动态方面，尤其是和你妈妈的关系。

sentences.en: But Almost Famous, I think it came out almost exactly 25 years ago.
sentences.zh: 但《成名在望》，我想它几乎正好是25年前上映的。

sentences.en: You've been thinking about this part of your life, these formative experiences for a long time now.
sentences.zh: 你很长时间以来一直在思考你人生中的这部分，这些塑造性的经历。

sentences.en: You've really been working through this material for years and years and years.
sentences.zh: 你真的花了好多年好多年在琢磨这些素材。

sentences.en: I'm a pack rat.
sentences.zh: 我是个囤积狂。

sentences.en: What are you still trying to figure out?
sentences.zh: 你还在试图弄清楚什么？

sentences.en: I think you're maybe an emotional pack rat.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你可能是一个情感上的囤积狂。

sentences.en: What are you still figuring out?
sentences.zh: 你到底还在弄清楚什么？

sentences.en: Really well said.
sentences.zh: 说得太好了。

sentences.en: Well, I love that time when everything meant life or death emotionally, and you really felt things, and you hadn't built up, like, many layers of leather-like skin.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我喜欢那种一切在情感上都意味着生死攸关的时光，那时你真的能感受到事情，而且你还没长出好几层皮革般的皮肤。

sentences.en: Like, oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 就像，哦，对。

sentences.en: When I first started directing, one of the things that really drove me crazy was when people would say, like,
sentences.zh: 当我刚开始导演的时候，真正让我抓狂的一件事就是人们会说，比如说，

sentences.en: that's not how it's done.
sentences.zh: 事情不是这么做的。

sentences.en: Let me show you how it works.
sentences.zh: 让我来教你这是怎么运作的。

sentences.en: And they didn't seem to have joy.
sentences.zh: 而他们似乎没有快乐。

sentences.en: And I wanted to never forget the joyful experience of following your dream and finding your fucking voice in the world, which to me is sometimes a youthful experience,
sentences.zh: 我想要永远不要忘记追逐梦想、在世界上找到你他妈的声音的快乐经历，对我来说，这有时是年轻时的经历，

sentences.en: and sometimes it doesn't happen until late in your life.
sentences.zh: 有时直到你晚年才会发生。

sentences.en: But I loved the journey of finding that kind of comfortable place where you know, like, this is who I am as a writer.
sentences.zh: 但我喜欢那种探索的过程，找到那个舒适的地方，你知道，比如，作为一名作家，这就是我。

sentences.en: This may even be who I am as a person.
sentences.zh: 这甚至可能就是作为一个人，这就是我。

sentences.en: So, um, I wanted to make sure that I wrote something that captured that feeling.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，我想确保我写的东西捕捉到了那种感觉。

sentences.en: Not through the mists of time, not through, like, a thick wall, a thick, you know, glass wall where you see, you know, yes, that's how it used to be.
sentences.zh: 不是通过时间的迷雾，不是通过厚厚的墙，一堵厚厚的，你知道的，你可以看到的那种玻璃墙，是的，过去就是这样的。

sentences.en: I wanted to write something about the time when Bowie was still alive,
sentences.zh: 我想写一些关于鲍伊还活着的时候的时光，

sentences.en: Glenn Frey was still alive.
sentences.zh: 格伦·弗雷还活着的时候。

sentences.en: And I wrote it for pure pleasure.
sentences.zh: 我是为了纯粹的快乐而写的。

sentences.en: And then eventually I knew it was going to get published.
sentences.zh: 然后最终我知道它会出版。

sentences.zh: 但在帕利塞兹大火爆发的前一晚，

sentences.zh: 我按下发送键把手稿交了上去，我当时想，大火要把我们的房子吞没了。

sentences.en: So I remember thinking, like, okay, I sent it in.
sentences.zh: 所以我记得当时想，好吧，我交了。

sentences.en: If I lose everything, I did write the thing that kind of captured the sum total of all those memories and everything I kept.
sentences.zh: 如果我失去了一切，我确实写下了那些捕捉到所有这些回忆总和以及我保留的一切的东西。

sentences.en: So I'm really proud of it.
sentences.zh: 所以我为此感到非常骄傲。

sentences.en: Can you put me back in a moment when you were, you know, 19 years old,
sentences.zh: 你能把我带回那个时刻吗？那时你，你知道，19岁，

sentences.en: doing what you were doing, and you thought, well, it's all happening?
sentences.zh: 做着你正在做的事，然后你觉得，哇，这一切正在发生？

sentences.en: Really, it started before that.
sentences.zh: 真的，从那之前就开始了。

sentences.en: It started, like, when I was 14 and 15,
sentences.zh: 从我14、15岁的时候就开始了，

sentences.en: when I just wanted to get backstage.
sentences.zh: 那时我只想去后台。

sentences.en: And I had all these questions.
sentences.zh: 我有一肚子的问题。

sentences.en: Like, I did way too much research and stuff.
sentences.zh: 比如，我做了过多的调查之类的。

sentences.en: And as a fan, I had, like, a huge notebook, generally.
sentences.zh: 作为粉丝，我通常有一个巨大的笔记本。

sentences.en: One, sometimes two, full of questions.
sentences.zh: 一本，有时两本，写满了问题。

sentences.en: So I think, like, people tended to show pity on me sometimes standing outside with this notebook full of questions and a tape recorder.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得，人们有时往往会对我产生怜悯，我站在外面拿着这本写满问题和录音机的笔记本。

sentences.en: It's like, let's let him in.
sentences.zh: 就像，让他进来吧。

sentences.en: And once I was in, David, I always found, like, the doors would open.
sentences.zh: 一旦我进去了，大卫，我总是发现，大门会敞开。

sentences.en: Like, you know, people like Jim Croce or Glenn Frey of the Eagles or these people whose music I really had questions about were so relieved and happy and excited
sentences.zh: 比如，你知道，像吉姆·克罗切或老鹰乐队的格伦·弗雷这样的人，或者这些我真的对他们的音乐有疑问的人，他们感到如此宽慰、高兴和兴奋，

sentences.en: that there was somebody who was actually a fan and knew their music standing in front of them with a tape recorder.
sentences.zh: 居然有一个真正是粉丝、了解他们音乐的人手里拿着录音机站在他们面前。

sentences.en: Turn it on, let's talk.
sentences.zh: 打开它，我们聊聊。

sentences.en: ask me whatever you want.
sentences.zh: 你想问什么就问什么。

sentences.en: So I just kept going with it.
sentences.zh: 所以我一直坚持下去了。

sentences.en: And was there something that you saw in those earliest days that made you think, like, oh, I'm seeing something that most people don't get to see?
sentences.zh: 在那些最早的日子里，有没有什么东西让你觉得，哦，我看到了一些大多数人看不到的东西？

sentences.en: Yeah, the hunger of people that weren't understood in their own adolescent life.
sentences.zh: 有的，那些在自己的青春期里不被理解的人的渴望。

sentences.en: They chose music because music chose them.
sentences.zh: 他们选择音乐，是因为音乐选择了他们。

sentences.en: And it was a day-to-day kind of crusade to, like, keep this life alive where they were understood.
sentences.zh: 这是一种日复一日的十字军东征，为了维持这种生活，让他们被理解的生活得以延续。

sentences.en: Also, there wasn't a feeling that rock was going to last that long.
sentences.zh: 另外，当时并没有人觉得摇滚乐能持续那么久。

sentences.en: So there was that thing of, like, well, we're making hay while, you know, the sun shines here.
sentences.zh: 所以当时有一种心态，那就是，趁着阳光正好，我们赶紧努力干吧。

sentences.en: But I saw a documentary on the Eagles recently where Don Henley said, you know, basically, we don't know what we're going to do when our real life starts.
sentences.zh: 但我最近看了一部关于老鹰乐队的纪录片，唐·亨利在里面说，基本上，我们不知道当我们的现实生活开始时该做什么。

sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他正在演绎这种恐惧。

sentences.zh: 那是55年之后的事了。

sentences.en: So everybody, I think, was kind of, like,

sentences.en: on an adventure, not knowing where it would end.
sentences.zh: 不知道它会以什么结束。

sentences.zh: 我认为我的现实生活开始于

sentences.zh: 简·韦纳把我叫去谈话，我本以为那是为了祝贺我让齐柏林飞艇上了《滚石》杂志的封面。

sentences.zh: 齐柏林飞艇讨厌《滚石》。

sentences.en: Led Zeppelin were the last band that you would ever expect to see in Rolling Stone because it was a well-known feud.
sentences.zh: 齐柏林飞艇是你最意想不到会在《滚石》里看到的乐队，因为那是一场众所周知的恩怨。

sentences.en: And Jan called me in to talk to him.
sentences.zh: 而简把我叫去跟他谈话。

sentences.en: And in fact, it was, yeah, you did well,
sentences.zh: 事实上，那是，是的，你干得不错，

sentences.en: but is it a real piece of writing?
sentences.zh: 但这是一篇真正的写作吗？

sentences.en: And this was a day where he had lost his own mentor,
sentences.zh: 而那正是他失去自己的导师的日子，

sentences.en: Ralph Gleason.
sentences.zh: 拉尔夫·格里森。

sentences.en: And he kind of was working his way through a bottle of vodka and didn't need to see me.
sentences.zh: 他当时正喝着一瓶伏特加，其实没必要见我。

sentences.en: He could have blown off the meeting, but he didn't.
sentences.zh: 他本可以推掉这个会面，但他没有。

sentences.en: And he talked to me about that.
sentences.zh: 他跟我谈了这件事。

sentences.en: And then he said, meet me at my home.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，到我家里来找我。

sentences.zh: 我后来在他的住所见到了他，他给了我一本琼·迪迪安的

sentences.zh: 《向伯利恒跋涉》，并说，读读这些东西，读读她早期关于门徒乐队的人物特写。

sentences.en: You'll see how to really write like a real writer.
sentences.zh: 你会明白如何真正像一个真正的作家那样写作。

sentences.en: And I was hurt, but also challenged.
sentences.zh: 我很受伤，但也受到了挑战。

sentences.zh: 从旧金山回来的那天路上，就是我的现实生活开始的时候。

sentences.zh: 所以那大概是1975年左右？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.zh: 你知道关于那个乐队你需要知道的一切。

sentences.zh: 而且你感觉自己就像坐在前排观看了一场经历，这正是我一直想做的事，作为一名作家去创造那种感觉。

sentences.en: Are there any experiences from those 70s days that stand out to you as ones that you, you know, have lingered with you, but you don't know how they fit
sentences.zh: 在70年代那些日子里，有没有什么经历对你来说很突出，你知道的，它们一直萦绕在你心头，但你不知道它们如何契合

sentences.zh: 你人生更宏大的故事？

sentences.zh: 鲍伊对我就有这种感觉，因为，你知道，我报道了他那个“瘦白公爵”时期，当时他在洛杉矶有些迷失，他允许我或要求我为他写一篇人物特写，

sentences.zh: 采访是在那段时间里进行的。

sentences.en: And it was a wild kind of glimpse of, you know, his own kind of untethered brilliance at the time.
sentences.zh: 那是对他在当时那种不受约束的才华的一种疯狂的一瞥。

sentences.zh: 但当我大约在2012年重新采访他时，

sentences.zh: 继续。

sentences.zh: 我知道你要谈论什么。

sentences.zh: 我想我让他感到有点忧郁和后悔，后悔我曾一瞥过他那段不受约束的时光。

sentences.en: And so what was fascinating to me was that time that he was slightly embarrassed about now was one of my most formative times.
sentences.zh: 所以对我而言迷人的是，他现在微微感到尴尬的那段时光，正是我最具塑造性的时光之一。

sentences.en: So that was something that made sense to me later because he was essentially telling me when I re-interviewed him like, hey, I'm glad you had a good time.
sentences.zh: 所以后来这对我来说就说得通了，因为当我重新采访他时，他基本上是在告诉我：嘿，我很高兴你当时过得愉快。

sentences.zh: 但在我们俩非常熟悉的这段时间里，我自己吓得要死，差点就死掉了。

sentences.en: But guess what?
sentences.zh: 但你知道吗？

sentences.en: So it's like, you know, you're hanging out with David Bowie in 1975, 76, whenever it was, when he was in his,
sentences.zh: 所以这就像是，你知道的，1975、76年左右，不管具体是哪年，你和戴维·鲍伊在一起闲逛，当时他正处于他的，

sentences.en: I believe it was like, maybe it's from one of your profiles of him.
sentences.zh: 我记得好像是，也许出自你对他的一篇人物专访。

sentences.en: He's like only eating peppers and drinking milk or something like that and thought he was being pursued by witches.
sentences.zh: 他当时只吃辣椒、喝牛奶之类的，还以为自己被女巫追踪。

sentences.en: And so you wrote this profile that kind of has like an effervescence to it, I would say.
sentences.zh: 所以你写的那篇专访，我想说，带有一种充满活力的神采。

sentences.en: And then when you spoke to Bowie about it later, you know, he basically says, I was mentally ill.
sentences.zh: 后来当你跟鲍伊谈起这件事时，你知道的，他基本上说的是，我当时精神失常了。

sentences.en: And I thought, like from a larger perspective, are there things that your age and perspective prevented you from seeing and therefore stopped you from putting into the stories?
sentences.zh: 我想，从一个更宏观的角度来看，有没有什么是你的年龄和阅历所局限，因而未能看到，也因此没能写进故事里的东西？

sentences.en: I think I always wanted to put my experience forward in the stories.
sentences.zh: 我想我一直都想在故事中呈现我的个人经历。

sentences.en: Some stuff would be in between the lines, but mostly I wanted people to feel what I felt.
sentences.zh: 有些东西会隐含在字里行间，但大部分时候我都希望人们能感受到我的感受。

sentences.en: And I'm still like that making movies.
sentences.zh: 我拍电影时依然是这样的。

sentences.en: It's like, I want to create that feeling.
sentences.zh: 就像是，我想创造那种感觉。

sentences.en: And it's the feeling that music gives you where you're,
sentences.zh: 那就是音乐给你的那种感觉，让你置身于，

sentences.en: you're transported into this place that's a safe, glorious kind of place.
sentences.zh: 把你带到一个安全、辉煌的美妙地方。

sentences.en: And it's not going to last forever, but you feel it while you're listening to this music that means so much or has touched your soul.
sentences.zh: 这不会永远持续下去，但当你聆听这首对你意义重大或触动心灵的音乐时，你能真切感受到它。

sentences.en: And I wanted to create that feeling journalistically too.
sentences.zh: 我也希望在新闻报道中创造出那种感觉。

sentences.en: Like I wanted you to feel like you were in the car riding with Bowie.
sentences.zh: 就像我希望你感觉自己正坐在鲍伊的车里兜风。

sentences.en: And this is the guy that you still don't really know that well in media.
sentences.zh: 而这就是你在媒体上其实仍然不是很了解的那个人。

sentences.en: He was a warm, hugely,
sentences.zh: 他是一个温暖、极其，

sentences.en: he could see, he kind of saw around corners musically and culturally and stuff.
sentences.zh: 他能看穿一切，在音乐和文化等方面有着某种先见之明。

sentences.en: And so his, his kind of lost weekend was more,
sentences.zh: 所以他那段，那种迷失的周末，比，

sentences.zh: 我觉得，比他自己愿意回想的还要精彩。

sentences.en: But the point was, I saw stuff, I saw glimpses of things, and I tended to write about it a lot.
sentences.zh: 但重点是，我看到了，我捕捉到了事情的吉光片羽，而且我倾向于对此进行大量描写。

sentences.en: But also to put you, the reader, into a place where you felt what I felt.
sentences.zh: 同时也为了把读者你，带到一个能感同身受的地方。

sentences.en: Do you think anything you learned from doing your job as a journalist, you were then able to bring back to the relationships with your family?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你从记者工作中学到的东西，有哪些后来能带回到与家人的关系中吗？

sentences.en: Ooh, ask me that again.
sentences.zh: 噢，请再问我一遍。

sentences.en: That's really a great question.
sentences.zh: 这真的是个好问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, because you were still a young man, you know, and young people, you know, in their late teens, early 20s, they're still kind of figuring out their relationships
sentences.zh: 对，因为你当时还是个年轻人，你知道的，年轻人，十多岁到二十出头的时候，他们还在摸索如何处理，

sentences.en: with their siblings, with their parents.
sentences.zh: 与兄弟姐妹、与父母的关系。

sentences.en: And you were in a situation where you're sort of practicing the art of understanding someone, of learning how to talk to all different kinds of people, of knowing when to listen,
sentences.zh: 而你当时处在这样一种情境中：你在练习如何去理解一个人，学习如何与各种各样的人对话，知道什么时候该倾听，

sentences.en: when to interject.
sentences.zh: 什么时候该插话。

sentences.en: It's a great question.
sentences.zh: 这是个好问题。

sentences.en: It teaches you to listen.
sentences.zh: 它教会你倾听。

sentences.en: It teaches you to have empathy.
sentences.zh: 它教会你保持同理心。

sentences.en: It teaches you to see people in very tough situations and, you know, how to read a room.
sentences.zh: 它教会你在极其艰难的处境中看待人们，以及，你知道的，如何察言观色。

sentences.en: It's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And I brought back a lot of empathy for my parents and for my sister because I could see the daily battles that everybody suffered, you know.
sentences.zh: 我从对父母和姐姐的理解中带回了许多同理心，因为我能看到每个人每天都在经历的挣扎，你知道的。

sentences.en: Some people think because I got published as a young guy and, you know, had success early on that was kind of obvious in Rolling Stone and stuff that, like,
sentences.zh: 有些人觉得，因为我很年轻就发表了作品，你知道的，很早就获得了成功，在《滚石》杂志上发表文章之类的，显得好像，

sentences.en: I was a Candide, you know, that life was just easy and I was just, like, cruising through every open door and, like, you know, he's living a Cinderella story.
sentences.zh: 我就是个老实单纯的人，你知道的，生活轻而易举，我只是顺风顺水地穿过每一扇敞开的门，就像是，你知道的，他在过着灰姑娘般的故事。

sentences.en: But it was tough, you know.
sentences.zh: 但其实很艰难，你知道的。

sentences.en: Everything is a negotiation in a way to get yourself access to get yourself in the position where you can do the interviews.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，一切都是一场谈判，为了争取采访机会，让自己站在能够进行采访的位置上。

sentences.zh: 另一个事实是，故事背后总有另一个故事。

sentences.en: What was the story behind the story with your family?
sentences.zh: 你家庭故事背后的故事是什么？

sentences.en: I think because I was the youngest and I was the last,
sentences.zh: 我想因为我是老幺，我是最后一个，

sentences.en: I was, for my mom in particular, it was,
sentences.zh: 对我的母亲来说尤其如此，

sentences.en: I was the one that they could get everything right with.
sentences.zh: 我是那个他们可以把所有事情都做对的孩子。

sentences.en: And so they came to it with a certain playbook that they learned from two children before me.
sentences.zh: 所以他们带着一套从我前面两个孩子身上学到的既定方法论来面对我。

sentences.en: So they reluctantly let me go out into the world and fight these battles and win and lose and stuff.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们勉强让我去外面的世界闯荡，去经历那些战役，有胜有负，诸如此类。

sentences.en: But it was,
sentences.zh: 但那是，

sentences.en: it was kind of me coming back
sentences.zh: 那有点像我带着，

sentences.en: wounded from some of those battles that provided some of our most important times where it was just me and my parents sitting around talking about the ups and downs of life
sentences.zh: 从其中某些战役中受到的伤痛回来，正是这些时刻构成了我们最珍贵的时光，当时只有我和父母坐在一起，谈论着生活的起起落落，

sentences.en: and how you have to fight to be optimistic and how being a warrior

sentences.en: for that kind of optimism is a good life to live.
sentences.zh: 乐观主义的斗士才是不枉此生。

sentences.en: And I think that that I learned with them as a family.
sentences.zh: 我想我作为家庭的一员，和他们一起学到了这一点。

sentences.en: You know, there's that phrase everywhere you go, there you are.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有句名言叫：无论你走到哪里，你都在那里。

sentences.en: You know, that's what I'm thinking about.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这就是我正在思考的。

sentences.en: It's impossible to avoid your journalism being a reflection of who you are.
sentences.zh: 你的新闻报道不可避免地会成为你自身面貌的反映。

sentences.zh: 所以我要稍微书呆子气一下，聊聊莱斯特·班斯，他可以说是，

sentences.en: rock critic who died I think in the early 80s and was still a young man just in his 30s
sentences.zh: 一位传奇的摇滚乐评论家，我想他在八十年代初去世时还很年轻，只有三十出头，

sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.zh: 他可以说是你的良师益友，在《成名在望》中他由菲利普·塞默·霍夫曼饰演，而在《成名在望》中，莱斯特·班斯这个角色有点像是，

sentences.zh: 新闻界和摇滚乐的道德良知，他有点像是以你为原型的威廉这个角色的欧比旺·克诺比式人物，电影里是这样，

sentences.en: and it's also in the book too
sentences.zh: 书中也是如此，

sentences.zh: 莱斯特曾警告你，不要被你所报道的人所迷惑。

sentences.zh: 你知道，不要写出那种把他们写得像个绝顶天才一样的报道。

sentences.zh: 不过我的问题是，

sentences.zh: 嗯，这是个有趣的事情，因为我最后一次见莱斯特时，那个说不要跟摇滚明星闲逛、不要跟摇滚明星交朋友的家伙，

sentences.en: and I think what he was saying and it's a fair question for sure is like don't sell yourself out like you're gonna be seduced you're gonna do all that like yeah you can be
sentences.zh: 我想他当时想表达的是——这确实是个合理的问题——就是别出卖自己，你会被迷惑的，你会经历这一切，就像是，对，你可以成为，

sentences.en: a so-called friend it may not last forever but you can be on a very kind of like you know almost a confessional basis with somebody
sentences.zh: 所谓的朋侪，这段关系可能不会持续永远，但你可以和某人保持一种，你知道的，几乎是忏悔室式的坦诚关系，

sentences.zh: 而且，

sentences.zh: 别试图加入乐队，别试图成为那样的人，你知道的，要保持距离去研究那个人，

sentences.en: and then like I always wanted to do I wanted to bring people along with me

sentences.en: Cashmere more because you get where it all came from well and sort of the in a convoluted way part of what I was trying to get at with the first part of my question is that
